elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The Company must pay HDI a specified Termination Payment when the Company terminates for convenience.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The only specified Customer-payable amount is triggered by the Company's termination for convenience and does not apply to termination for HDI's breach or failure to perform.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment equals the aggregate Section 3.1 fees for the three calendar months preceding termination, so it cannot exceed three months of such fees.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause states that the Termination Payment is the “sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company by reason of such termination.”
